17/S0.subgoal: Summarize the different types of elements that can be tracked in a virtual reality system.

17/S1.subgoal: Describe the overall components and stages involved in the tracking process.

17/S2.subgoal: Describe the structure and components of an Inertial Measurement Unit (IMU) sensor.

17/S3.subgoal: Explain how the different sensors within an IMU contribute to tracking estimation.

17/S4.subgoal: Explain the methodology and purpose of sensor calibration.

17/S5.subgoal: Describe the process of establishing initial sensor alignment (registration).

17/S6.subgoal: Explain how sensory data is integrated to compute orientation over time.

17/S7.subgoal: Describe how drift correction utilizes multiple sensor inputs to improve accuracy.

17/S8.subgoal: Summarize the primary function of each of the four tracking stages: calibration, registration, integration, and drift correction.

17/S9.subgoal: Review the concepts covered in the lecture and preview the topics for the next session.
